body:

title: Impeccably modern 1 bedroom 1 bath condo
body: Impeccably modern 1 bedroom 1 bath condominium located in the vibrant & hip Bernal & SoCha neighborhoods. Facing the quiet rear of the complex, the hustle & bustle of Mission St. is quickly forgotten. An abundance of natural light gleams, w/ sliding glass doors leading to the delightfully spacious, peaceful & sunny patio - great for indoor/outdoor living! Dazzling hardwood floors & stunning light fixtures are sure to delight. Large master bedroom with walk-in closet, providing ample room for your wardrobe. Full-sized brightly remodeled bathroom with shower over tub wont disappoint. Updated kitchen with contemporary cabinets & stainless-steel appliances. Designated garage parking w/ highly coveted storage space. Onsite laundry room located near the unit. Just steps away from all the trendy shops, restaurants, parks & hiking trails this area has to offer with convenient access to major bus lines, commuter shuttles, BART, 101 & 280 Fwys.

title: spacious & stylish 2-story condo
body: Panoramic views of SF, the Bay & East Bay! Unique, spacious & stylish 2-story condo in an intimate 4-unit building located in Fairmount, just above Noe Valley, minutes to BART & freeways, offering privacy, sophistication and peacefulness. A gated entrance into a small courtyard welcomes you. Unit features nice living & dining areas w/ views, hardwood floors & an open chef's kitchen with high-end S/S appliances & elegant granite counters. Downstairs you'll find a large 1 Bedroom suite PLUS a space for a work-from-HOME OFFICE. A large walk-in closet + a second one offers great storage. There's a remodeled bath with a shower over the tub & laundry closet, complete with a washer & dryer set. A one car garage on the same level w/ extra storage is a great plus! Fabulous location close to shops, restaurants, parks, public transportation, freeways, yet offers a pleasant, suburban-like environment!
